environment.description: Same service deployed on RHEL 9 with a custom SELinux type enforcement policy (webapp_upload_t) compiled from a .te module. The policy confines the process to type webapp_upload_t which has file transition rules limited to: allow webapp_upload_t webapp_spool_t:file { create read write rename unlink getattr }; allow webapp_upload_t webapp_spool_t:dir { search add_name remove_name write }; with /var/spool/webapp(/.*)? labeled webapp_spool_t. All other file contexts result in AVC denial. The policy also restricts the process from executing any binary not labeled bin_t via: neverallow webapp_upload_t ~bin_t:file execute; Additionally, a boolean httpd_can_network_connect is set to off. The SELinux mode is enforcing with MLS sensitivity s0 applied to the process context. Note: the base policy does NOT include allow rules for etc_t, shadow_t, proc_t, or any type outside webapp_spool_t for file operations.
